Namespace: UnityEngine.InputSystem.PS5
Assembly: solution.dll
Syntax
[InputControlLayout(stateType = typeof(GamepadStatePS5), displayName = "PS5 DualSense (on PS5)")]
[Preserve]
public class DualSenseGamepad : DualShockGamepad, IDualShockHaptics, IDualMotorRumble, IHaptics

Properties

acceleration

Acceleration of the Controller

Declaration
public Vector3Control acceleration { get; }
Property Value
Type Description
Vector3Control
Remarks

Data from this control is converted from Right to Left-handed coordinates space to match Unity's coordinates space. To read the raw (uncorrected) value from the SDK use ReadValueUnprocessed()

angularVelocity

Angular Velocity of the Controller with the axis in radians per second

Declaration
public Vector3Control angularVelocity { get; }
Property Value
Type Description
Vector3Control
Remarks

Data from this control is converted from Right to Left-handed coordinates space to match Unity's coordinates space and inverted so that positive rotation matches the positive direction of the rotation axis To read the raw (uncorrected) value from the SDK use ReadValueUnprocessed()
